cases.ask: I need leave next Friday for a doctor's appointment
cases.reference: A card: the date and reason already filled in; leave type (with balances) and full or half day as choices.

cases.ask: I need half a day off tomorrow for a doctor's appointment
cases.reference: The first sentence of the feature: asks the leave type and which half, nothing else.

cases.ask: Apply a casual leave for the full day next Tuesday, I have a family function
cases.reference: No choices: the HRMS checks it and the card waits for Confirm.

cases.ask: I want to apply for leave
cases.reference: Which day? — the one thing the assistant asks itself.

cases.ask: Approve the leave requests waiting for me
cases.reference: Only project managers and HR decide leave; an employee has nothing waiting on them.

cases.ask: Help me set my MBOs for this quarter
cases.reference: A line or two on role, mentor, project and plan status; one short note on anything missing; three numbered MBOs (objective, KPI dated inside the quarter, weightage, why it matters) totalling 100; then: refine them, or save as a Draft? No card yet.

ask: Help me set my MBOs for this quarter
The second one is not in my control
cases.reference: Asks briefly what did not fit or offers a genuinely different second MBO, not a rewording; the three still total 100. Nothing saved.

cases.ask: Suggest my MBOs for this quarter and save them
cases.reference: Suggestions are not an agreed set: shows the three and asks whether to save them as a Draft, rather than proposing the save.
